seed.tooltip: Current seed. Output once per queue, then advanced by the mode widget after the prompt is sent.

PersistentSeedSequence_Seed.name: PersistentSeedSequence_Seed
PersistentSeedSequence_Seed.description: CPU-only seed source. Outputs the current seed as an integer, exactly once per queue. A browser extension then advances the seed according to the selected mode (fixed / increment / decrement / randomize-after-queue) and shows the value that was just used as a separate, read-only last-used seed. Selected mode, current seed, widget order and the last-used seed all persist across workflow save and reload.
